Claim type: bounded_theorem

# Autonomous control of a supplied finite energy-history circuit

Can a supplied finite coherent history circuit run on the original physical chain under the supplied static interacting-copy controller, while retaining its full recorded output and an honest energy ledger? The accepted conditional application below gives the channel and resource bounds for that question. It analyzes final record pinching as a mathematical map; a physical measurement apparatus remains an additional task.

**Current status: accepted conditional analytic source; proposed_retained is a target, not an audit outcome.** Root acceptance `7001245f160065b2240036815ab7c52fe4a9ac2da83fd37ec2b0d0cff11c630e` controls the current source status. The complete V2 body, `603d0db2940710d291aa6025a6ae2ed1d5d5f9a1a0212e12e8834f3f300714e0`, appears unchanged below. Its historical “not accepted” and source-write sentences describe its original creation and are preserved as evidence. This wrapper adds no mathematics, scientific execution, independent review or retained status. The downstream physical implementation remains unnamed; no new native or kinetic claim is introduced.

## Exact imports and physical identification

| Mathematical input | Exact binding and role |
|---|---|
| [Interacting-copy controller](INTERACTING_COPY_AUTONOMOUS_CONTROLLER_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-14.md) | Raw source `3c02940e2d4f3eb519f459dd658950df77662c7bd431500e52f2509658ed94fe`, with conditional acceptance `676a5f6e420a0cce54e20a08fd82b8cba953298c41688daaa247c4ac0e1aec93`. Imports the complete channel, locality, positivity, effective fuel selection and actual ledger with its exact supplied hypotheses. The canonical note has SHA `f19a05ddea11fd3bd0cf3d463491707fb1ca106fab32611e2fd27361e468aa28`, actually committed in regular OPEN PR9533 at `bf476b0c6c1dfa4938a5db99a617177272eb4ca4`. Complete direct-body extraction is recorded in `PARENT_BINDINGS.json`. |
| [Fixed-history application](FINITE_CHAIN_ENERGY_HISTORY_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-14.md) | Direct body `7fe0df39ecad4aafbbbbfeeae83d2e2372f6527afbaf04223d9ab43dd5ac99b1`, exactly embedded in canonical `docs/FINITE_CHAIN_ENERGY_HISTORY_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-14.md`, SHA `839547b9ba88ecb37d72ab43094f02a34f6ac04bd14700bab034fbd99b0e0c2d`. Supplied PR9529 parent resolves locally to `6d2c1c96976d44c4082863d05132c37b92eef4c8`. Imports one common physical volume and complete weighted readout compilation on its fixed preparation range. |

Supply a computable finite unitary or circuit on the original chain and its declared record/work registers, together with its complete circuit-to-history certificate. Fixed-history scalar model, support and control-budget data alone do not compute arbitrary measurable drive waveforms. A probabilities-only certificate is insufficient. The deferred-read construction requires supplied stage dilations/unitary completions, preserved old record values and no reuse of discarded environments. The bin convention and within-bin coherence remain those of the fixed-history parent.

The original positive chain Hamiltonian, including endpoint terms and scalar shift, remains unchanged. Record/work qubits have declared diagonal nonnegative energies and zero joining bonds. The enlarged chain is an engineered inhomogeneous source; every fuel/router copies that full ordered Hamiltonian. Exact stationary router preparation, coherent fresh fuel, controller supports and observation time are supplied resources. The physical output is the original source, not a relabeled router.

For the fixed-history corollary, `N_A=W_Lambda* N W_Lambda` is the pullback of positive-Fock particle number under the actual finite-chain embedding. It is not computational-basis excitation count or the number of all apparatus qubits. The weight acts trivially on records, application work and passive references. With `W_n=(n+1)^(2s)`, the unchanged proof gives the complete weighted error

    E_vol + E_comp + E_circ + W_n(epsilon_U+eta_app).

Every outcome block is unnormalized and retains its quantum state and arbitrary passive reference. A varying input preparation needs its separate weighted-tail/preparation certificate. Each chosen common volume needs its own circuit, fuel and controller; no joint volume/time/kinetic uniformity is asserted.

## Resources, precision and energy

For `q=n+r+w` enlarged source qubits, `d=2^q`, `Theta=4pi d`, the construction uses `L=M(8q+1)`, observation time `pi(L+1)/(2J_c)` and `q+12Mq+M+1` active qubits. Runtime-dependent fuel compensates the free phase of the entire enlarged source. The inherited engineered geometry has term diameter at most 400 and arity at most six, with the explicit site-strength bounds in the proof. External preparation equipment, a physical measurement device, stable storage and reset are not included in the count.

The precision theorem used here is the broad controller class: exact original enlarged source, positive copy mismatch, self-adjoint cut errors with exactly zero endpoints, general possibly nonunitary local hopping-block errors, and a joint controller-resource preparation allowance. The narrower fresh-fuel/unitary-error supplement is not substituted into those estimates. The preparation telescope is sufficient and imposes no universal necessary per-fuel accuracy rate. Scalar clock-number energy padding is distinguished from adding idle path steps.

The actual initial moments include pointer/work energies on every fuel copy and the first-hop contribution to the coupled-Hamiltonian variance. The exact endpoint fuel change pays the enlarged source change, including its pointer and application-work energy. At imperfect completion the ledger retains router, dual-rail, cut and hopping energy changes. Mathematical partial trace does not dispose of energy or reset workspace.

Original-record pinching fixes the bare energy. Its full-Hamiltonian mean-energy defect vanishes at a sharp terminal head with exactly zero terminal cut; it is not a full-operator commutation claim. Imperfect completion is charged separately by

    |Delta E_read| <= 2 B_1 Gamma_0 + 2 B_all eta_ctrl.

This uses a full-device state comparison, not merely the source marginal. Zero mean-energy change for this mathematical map does not construct or price a physical readout apparatus, heat, resetting, stopping or stable storage.

## Proof and review record

The conditional obligation graph is in `PROOF_OBLIGATIONS.md`; exact source bindings are in `DEPENDENCIES.json`. The full body supplies the enlargement and coherent-history interface, CPTP/weighted composition, resource substitution, actual ledger and pinching estimate. Its parent theorems remain conditional analytic imports rather than retained authorities.

The archive preserves original V1 `d385cb20…`, the complete original root and separate reviews, both wording findings, exact two-paragraph V2 repair and separate delta confirmation. The separate full review is `b7a47333…`; the delta is `d8ca599c…`; root's final review is `0c9ffe74…`. The repair narrows a sufficient preparation statement and names scalar clock padding. No formula or author control was changed.

The preserved four-qubit author control uses a selected state with bare-energy commutation and unchanged record marginal but full mean-energy change `-2lambda sqrt(p(1-p))`. Its complete source, actual output, empty stderr and receipt are archived. It is a state/observable witness, not an asserted controller trajectory, a diamond-norm certificate or a general no-go. The two-component proof is in the unchanged body. No numerical control was rerun in this assembly.

## Publication conditions

The proposed destination is `docs/INTERACTING_CONTROLLER_HISTORY_APPLICATION_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-14.md`, packet `toe-interacting-history-20261014`. The two canonical parent links and complete direct-body extractions are verified on actual parent `bf476b0c6c1dfa4938a5db99a617177272eb4ca4`, regular OPEN PR9533. Its source-only publication packet records both exact canonical hashes and all conditional import roles. Root then reviews the separate driver-bound source-integration acceptance before canonical execution. The primary runner `scripts/interacting_controller_history_application_identity_2026_10_14.py` performs source identity/reconstruction only, with zero mathematical predicates. Canonical driver/cache, citation graph and combined integration validation remain unrun by this preparer. These are publication conditions, not missing algebra supplied by this package.

`SOURCE_MAP.json` maps the exact complete proof extraction and archived provenance. `EVIDENCE_MANIFEST.json`, `PROCEDURE_MANIFEST.json` and `READ_COVERAGE.json` distinguish immutable evidence, procedure snapshots and prior readings. The local `source_check.py` performs zero mathematical predicates. Its results and `FINAL_FREEZE.json` establish byte consistency only.
